condition_contract.all: Every clause must match; empty all is true.
condition_contract.any: Optional; at least one clause must match when nonempty.
condition_contract.default_by: Resolve only for an explicit selected value; no fallback to the first choice.
condition_contract.unknown_required: Unknown user-required condition must be visible or blocked. Missing built-in provider material is a preset/app setup blocker, never a demand that ordinary users fill our missing fixed URL/client data.

prd.scope: AI-CFG typed credentials, independent purposes, explicit versions and only applicable parameters

auth.scope: Exact registered auth kinds; salt/signing/refresh are internal

registry.scope: Exact protocol/profile/preset/engine identities and purpose ceilings

offline.scope: Four engine conditions, real resource observation and unknown blocking

deepseek.scope: OpenAI base URL, API Key and actual model input; examples are not model defaults

qwen.scope: Region-specific key/address/model; Beijing compatible base verified; unverified built-in sites are independently blocked as incomplete preset materials; user endpoint input is required only for an explicit custom-server configuration

ark.scope: Official Markdown fetched directly; Beijing data-plane base and API-key/model contract verified. Other sites not guessed.

gemini_compatible.scope: Gemini API key, compatible base URL and actual model

gemini_native.scope: Official generateContent reference opened; v1beta host and required model verified.

openrouter.scope: Base URL, API Key and explicit model; app attribution optional

openai.scope: Bearer key, v1 host; organization/project headers conditionally needed; Chat and Responses remain separate presets

anthropic.scope: API host, API Key and model; workspace selection conditional; current registry keeps its exact Anthropic API-key contract

ollama.scope: Different native/compatible local base URLs; local no-auth and remote/cloud API-Key conditions

lmstudio.scope: Compatible local URL example assumes port 1234; editable assumption, not installed-server guarantee

lmstudio_native.scope: Official quickstart confirms default localhost:1234, api/v1/chat and optional server authentication; model example is not a chosen default.

azure.scope: Subscription key; regional/multiservice region required, global region optional; custom endpoints need explicit selection

deepl.scope: Free versus Pro host and authentication key; no model ID required

google_v2.scope: Exact v2 translate URL; target language and API-key route already registered

google_v3.scope: translate.googleapis.com/v3, project/location and optional model; OAuth/IAM contract remains local authority

baidu.scope: Current official indexed doc explicitly identifies HTTPS vip/translate endpoint and APPID+secret signing; page HTML shell omitted body, no live invocation.

youdao.scope: Official HTML fetched directly (60366 bytes); text-translation HTTPS endpoint, appKey/secret and signing fields verified. No live call.

tokenhub.scope: Separate Chat and dedicated translations routes, Bearer key and explicit model; no sample model silently selected

deepl_translate.scope: Translation context is an optional service-specific field; not generic LLM prompting.

presentation_policy.entry: Choose purpose, brand and exact interface/engine before showing necessary fields; no automatic interface switching.
presentation_policy.secrets: Masked input means API Key/application secret; only opaque references enter normal draft/saved state. Design samples never accept real production keys.
presentation_policy.default_sources: Only reviewed fixed/site/plan values are preset. Missing built-in default material stays blocked/pending with a reason; ordinary users never supply our missing fixed service information. Custom URL is entered only after an explicit custom-server choice.
presentation_policy.advanced: Only applicable settings are disclosed; retain independent purpose templates/runtime/context and key management.
presentation_policy.eligibility: Presentation is not execution authority: keep saved-only translation selection, version, known-failure and local-health gates.
presentation_policy.production_authority: Future Rust app-core derives typed field and eligibility projections through narrow Tauri; this JSON is a design catalog, not executable protocol/plugin/DDL authority.
presentation_policy.preset_materials: Each service may declare preset_material_blockers with ordinary condition objects and user reasons; these affect eligibility independently from user field completeness.
